about: What each plane runs of the harnesses, as `plane/etc/dockerfiles/datalayer-harnesses/check_register.py --image <image> --markdown` read it inside the image (services). Updated by hand at each roll; the generator refuses a rolled version the register does not pin.

rolls.sidecar: off (DATALAYER_RUNTIME_HARNESS_SIDECAR): the image is prepulled on every node, the pod launches the adapters from the runtime image
